mapping.behavior: Latest-resource subscription matching skips multi-season TV before material lookup. An exact single-season explicitly numbered magnet can be added without preflight file selection.

native.kind: Native Linux amd64 App, installed indexed worker and native SDK callback observer with owned loopback protocol peers
observations: One verified Lark /subscribes refresh recognized a TV candidate with explicit S01E02 and excluded a higher-seeded S01–S02 candidate before any material request.
A same-origin authenticated tracker material request returned the magnet. qBittorrent received one exact whole URI without tracker Cookie, and the native SDK observer received it as a string.
This run verified TV Add and the ordinary callback. It did not test TV import or BestVersion replacement.
native.shared_command: This scenario passed on its first execution. The same invocation's two ordinary-chat fixture failures are separate observations.

adaptations_and_open: The filter is shared by RSS and spider refresh, as in the pinned source. This distinct run covered RSS only. Ordinary chat intentionally retains source multi-season candidates.
